'''Chris McNeil''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 7th at [[April 2001 Flatwoods tournament]] on 14 April 2001 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down with dueling]], according to John Tatta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2085">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-15-flatwoods-ky-4-14-01d2085/ flatwoods-ky-4-14-01], DeckTech (John "Artoo-Detoo" Tatta, 15 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-15-flatwoods-ky-4-14-01d2085/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
